_comment: CLASH_WIN/CLASH_LOSE were flags nothing sets, and this card does not clash -- it WAGERS (CR 8.5.46). Both branches were also identical, so even a working flag would have produced the same result either way. A wager could previously only pay out a token, so 'the winner loses 1{h}' had no expression; the wager now carries its source card and dispatches ON_WAGER_RESOLVED back to it.
